description: Canonical engineering parts. Quantities live only in physical assembly usages.

parts.name: AS5600 magnetic angle sensor + magnet
requirements: Optional dancer/tension sensing for cable-compliance mechanism; not required to block first V1 motion prototype.

parts.name: 608-2RS sealed bearing
requirements: 8×22×7 mm rubber-sealed bearings. Two per independent drum support plus extras for guides/tensioners.

parts.name: 1000 µF 5 V rail bulk capacitor
requirements: Low-ESR capacitor sized/rated appropriately above 5 V; one installed + spare; buffers servo-current spikes.

parts.name: IP68 cable gland assortment
requirements: Mix M12/M16/M20 for cabinet, post-driver boxes and dock/pod wiring.

parts.name: Pan/tilt camera gimbal
requirements: Lightweight 2-axis Camera Module 3 gimbal; approx. ±90° pan and 0–70° tilt target.
parts.notes: Includes the camera-gimbal concept family and the alternative payload mount family, with dry bench and integrated ordinary-rain/splash configurations. Select one arrangement; these sources are not a combined print kit. The current enclosure uses one-piece tapered outer payload-integrated-gimbal-head r0.1.2 with a separate payload-integrated-gimbal-carrier r0.1.1, both moving in pan, in place of the legacy pan yoke, fixed fairing and tilt-servo boot. Four M2 x 10 clamp stacks join the head and carrier. The compact kit uses payload-integrated-camera-cradle and payload-integrated-tilt-pivot-support r0.1.0, omits the rear camera cowl and its four secondary nuts, and uses four M2 x 12 camera screws. The legacy cradle, pivot support, yoke and shields remain alternative sources and are not printed for this configuration. The selected compact kit exports 13 fabrication models including the optional coupon and installs 16 printed pieces. Quantities, hardware and cable routes are in hardware/assemblies/camera-pod/payload-mounts.md and payload-enclosure.md. Servo/connector dimensions are provisional; source checks do not validate physical fit, rain protection or flying mass. The compact integrated variant substitutes payload-integrated-camera-hood r0.1.1 as the rounded white optical surround; the dry bench hood remains an alternative.

parts.name: Camera pod spider/chassis
requirements: ASA/PETG lightweight cable spider and electronics chassis sized for Raspberry Pi 3A+, 48 V → 5 V converter and bulk capacitor fixed on the pod. Complete flying pod target ~100–120 g; hard design limit 170 g.
parts.notes: Includes the camera-pod concept family and the alternative payload mount family, sharing the unchanged camera-pod-spider. Select one arrangement; these sources are not a combined print kit. The integrated ordinary-rain/splash configuration uses compact payload-integrated-deck r0.1.0 instead of the dry bench deck and replaces payload-electronics-cover with payload-rain-hood r0.2.1 and payload-enclosure-base r0.2.2. Its pan-moving payload-integrated-gimbal-head belongs to the camera-gimbal part; the separate fixed payload-pan-fairing remains a historical alternative and is omitted from the current enclosure kit. Quantities, hardware and cable routes are in hardware/assemblies/camera-pod/payload-mounts.md and payload-enclosure.md. Physical fit, rain/thermal behavior and complete flying mass remain unverified. Updated for Raspberry Pi 3A+ V1 pod architecture; replaces earlier Pi Zero 2 W mass/layout assumptions.

parts.name: Capsule slip ring, ≥6 channels × 2 A
requirements: Use three channels in parallel for +48 V and three for GND. One installed on powered-line winch + one spare.

parts.name: CL57Y-V20 closed-loop motor driver
requirements: Provided by the selected StepperOnline 4-axis V2.0 kit; exact included model must match the captured kit specification.

parts.name: Central outdoor electrical cabinet
requirements: IP65+ approx. 400×300/400×200 mm, large enough for both 48 V PSUs, Pico, protection, fusing and cable management.
parts.notes: IP65/IP66 cabinet with equivalent usable internal dimensions is preferred if cheaper.

parts.name: 48 V → 5 V controller buck converter
requirements: Input rating ≥60 V; 5 V output with sufficient current for Pico 2 W and cabinet auxiliaries.

parts.name: Ground-contact treated timber corner post
requirements: Approx. 100×100 mm square or Ø100–140 mm round; 3.8–4.0 m total; 0.8–1.0 m direct embedment; ~3.0 m exposed.
parts.notes: Recorded candidate source for ~4 m pressure-treated ground-contact poles. Final post section/diameter and treatment must match structural requirement.

parts.name: DIN-rail GND distribution block
requirements: DIN-rail ground distribution block with enough terminals for Pico/controller ground plus dedicated STEP and DIR return conductors for four CL57Y-V20 driver branches.
parts.notes: Mount in central cabinet next to Pico terminal board. Keeps field Cat5e returns on proper screw terminals rather than stacking multiple wires into one Pico breakout terminal.

parts.name: High-dock alignment funnel
requirements: Approx. 250–300 mm approach opening guiding the pod toward the separate locating nest; dock capture at ~2.65–2.70 m.

parts.name: High-dock locating nest
requirements: One locating socket and mounting plate receiving the pod after the separate alignment funnel.

parts.name: Dock mushroom locating stud + passive latch hardware
requirements: Centred pod stud, passive spring latch, stainless pivot pins/bolts; magnets optional for centring only, not structural retention.

parts.name: Dock weather roof / hood
requirements: Approx. 300×300 mm sloped rain/sun cover with drainage and unobstructed optical opening.

parts.name: 1.5 mm Dyneema positioning line, 50 m
requirements: Four primary positioning lines. Approx. 50 m per spool gives installation and termination margin.

parts.name: Waterproof emergency-stop switch
requirements: 22 mm mushroom E-stop with normally-closed contacts for hardwired motor safety path.

parts.name: Stainless extension spring assortment
requirements: Candidate springs for future/optional cable dancer tensioners.

parts.name: 8 mm → 8 mm flexible jaw coupling
requirements: Flexible jaw coupling, approximately D20/L25, 8 mm motor shaft to independent 8 mm drum shaft.

parts.name: Guy ground anchor
requirements: Approx. 800 mm or stronger ground anchor; actual capacity must be verified by pull test in site soil.
parts.notes: Prototype guy-anchor example from recorded baseline. Must be validated by pull test in actual site soil before relying on it.

parts.name: M12 guy turnbuckle
requirements: Galvanized/stainless turnbuckle for each outward post guy.

parts.name: 3 mm stainless/galvanized guy wire
requirements: Approximate total; final length after post/anchor geometry.

parts.name: Heat-set threaded insert assortment
requirements: M3/M4/M5 brass inserts for printed assemblies.

parts.name: Matched closed-loop motor cable
requirements: Provided by the selected StepperOnline 4-axis V2.0 kit; exact included model must match the captured kit specification.

parts.name: Micro pan/tilt servo
requirements: ~3.7 g digital micro servo; two-axis camera gimbal only, Pi/power stage remain fixed to pod.

parts.name: 32 GB microSD card
requirements: 32 GB microSD for pod Linux OS, local capture buffer and logs.

parts.name: 48 V motor power branch cable
requirements:
Outdoor/burial-rated low-voltage cable for central cabinet to four corner drivers. Final length confirmed after cabinet position is fixed.

Cabinet positioned at one corner would need 9m A>B, 32m A>C and 9m C>D.

parts.name: 3.0 Nm NEMA 23 closed-loop motor
requirements: Provided by the selected StepperOnline 4-axis V2.0 kit; exact included model must match the captured kit specification.

parts.name: Outdoor Cat5e signal cable
requirements: Outdoor-rated Cat5e; four point-to-point controller-to-driver runs. Each twisted pair carries STEP+return, DIR+return, optional enable/alarm/spare.

parts.name: 52Pi EP-0145 Screw Terminal Expansion Board
requirements: Solderless screw-terminal breakout for Raspberry Pi Pico/Pico 2. Headered Pico plugs directly into board; exposes GPIO and power/ground on labeled screw terminals for field wiring.
parts.notes: Solderless screw-terminal breakout. Alternative source: https://www.kiwi-electronics.com/en/terminal-expansion-board-for-raspberry-pi-pico-11279

parts.name: 48 V → 5 V pod buck converter
requirements: Input rating ≥60 V; 48 V nominal input; regulated 5 V output; ≥3 A. One active + one spare.

parts.name: AWG26 flexible silicone wire — black
requirements: High-flex fine-strand black conductor helically wrapped around one Dyneema line for pod GND.
parts.notes: Prototype geometry basis from owner-supplied AWG26 table on 2026-09-08: insulated OD 1.5 mm, 30 strands × 0.08 mm, claimed copper area 0.15 mm². Applies provisionally to the selected variant; not a delivered measurement. Supersedes earlier buyer-comment dimensions. Evidence and limitations: bom/sourcing/pod-wire-dimensions-2026-09-08.md.

parts.name: AWG26 flexible silicone wire — red
requirements: High-flex fine-strand red conductor helically wrapped around one Dyneema line for pod +48 V.
parts.notes: Prototype geometry basis from owner-supplied AWG26 table on 2026-09-08: insulated OD 1.5 mm, 30 strands × 0.08 mm, claimed copper area 0.15 mm². Applies provisionally to the selected variant; not a delivered measurement. Supersedes earlier buyer-comment dimensions. Evidence and limitations: bom/sourcing/pod-wire-dimensions-2026-09-08.md.

parts.name: IP65/IP67 ABS post electronics box
requirements: Approx. 150×100×70 mm or sized after driver/mount CAD; four corner boxes + one spare.

parts.name: 48 V / 350 W power supply
requirements: Provided by the selected StepperOnline 4-axis V2.0 kit; exact included model must match the captured kit specification.

parts.name: Round-pole split-clamp pulley mount concept pair
requirements: Alternative concept for a measured 100–140 mm round pole. One front collar/clevis plus one rear collar, with four nominal M8 clamp bolts and a separate M8 pulley pin.
STLs support fit and appearance mock-ups only. Structural material, manufacturing process, friction/slip resistance, timber movement and allowable loads are unverified.
parts.notes: Not included in any build or purchasing quantity; does not replace the through-bolted top-pulley-bracket baseline. Nominal hardware and generic pulley envelopes are not supplied fabrication parts.

parts.name: Rear backing plate for top-pulley bracket — stacked BAUHAUS plates
requirements: Stabilit 100 × 200 × 2 mm galvanized perforated steel plate. Stack two plates per post to make an approximately 4 mm rear backing plate; drill two aligned Ø13 mm holes for M12 through-bolts.
parts.notes: Eight plates total: two per post. Spreads cyclic pulley load across the timber and reduces local crushing.

parts.name: M12 galvanized locking nut for pulley bracket
requirements: Galvanized M12 DIN 985 nylon-insert locking nut; one per through-bolt, two per post and eight total.
parts.notes: Linked BAUHAUS product is sold as a 50-piece box. Re-check clamp after timber settlement; replace the nut if the nylon insert is damaged or repeatedly removed.

parts.name: M8 A4 shackle for pulley-to-bracket connection
requirements: Marinetech short round A4 stainless shackle with 8 mm removable pin; one per pulley. Pass through the bracket's Ø9 mm terminal hole and the pulley attachment.
parts.notes: Confirm the selected pulley fits and articulates freely without side-plate distortion. If incompatible, use an M8 A2/A4 bolt with spacers/washers and a locking nut as the attachment pin.

parts.name: M12 × 160 galvanized 8.8 through-bolt for pulley bracket
requirements: DIN 931, class 8.8, galvanized M12 × 160 mm hex through-bolt; two per post. Length suits 100–120 mm timber plus 5 mm angle, two 2 mm backing plates, washers and locking nut; confirm against actual stack before purchase.
parts.notes: Project uses 8; linked BAUHAUS product is sold as a 40-piece box. Do not use DIN 571 wood/coach screws.

parts.name: M12 DIN 9021 large washer for pulley bracket
requirements: Galvanized DIN 9021 washer, 13 mm ID × 37 mm OD × 3 mm thick. Use one under every M12 bolt head and one under every locking nut: four per post, 16 total.
parts.notes: Linked BAUHAUS product is sold as a 100-piece box.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi 3A+
requirements: Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+ for the flying pod: Camera Module 3 capture/autofocus, Wi-Fi image upload, local capture buffering and pan/tilt control. Full-size 15-pin CSI camera connector avoids the special Pi Zero ribbon.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Standard
requirements: Standard-FOV 12 MP autofocus version, Wide or Standard.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W with headers
requirements: Central deterministic 4-axis motion controller generating synchronized STEP/DIR. Must be the pre-soldered-header version so it plugs directly into the 52Pi EP-0145 terminal board without soldering.
parts.notes: Keep in central cabinet; plug into 52Pi EP-0145 screw-terminal expansion board.

parts.name: Winch home/reference and docked position roller microswitch
requirements: Roller-lever microswitch, e.g. KW12-3 class. Four installed for lines and 1 for docking + spares.

parts.name: 8 mm clamp shaft collar
requirements: Clamp-style rather than grub-screw-only if possible.

parts.name: Stainless metric fastener assortment
requirements: M3/M4/M5/M6 bolts, washers and nyloc nuts for printed assemblies.

parts.name: Top positioning-line pulley
requirements: Weather-resistant 25–30 mm marine single block for ~1.5 mm Dyneema; 30 mm preferred. Low-friction ball bearing preferred for repeated movement; positive side enclosure plus printed keeper. Mount near ~3.0–3.1 m on the through-bolted offset steel bracket.
parts.notes: Purchased prototype: Barton BA01090 30 mm STANDARD, WASI, https://wasi.hr/kolotura-jednostruka-fiksna-za-uze-do-8m; four units collected in store, confirmed 2026-10-08. Supplier lists a plain bearing; repeated-movement friction and retention remain unverified. Alternative: Allen A2030 30 mm Dynamic, 26 g, SWL 140 kg. Other alternatives: Harken 348 29 mm fixed Carbo; Lewmar 30 mm Control, https://www.imnasa.com/hr/katroli/control-pulley-simple-30mm-black-lewmar-l29901321bk; Viadana 25 mm fixed stainless, https://www.imnasa.com/hr/katroli/fixed-block-simple-25mm-s-s-viadana-28000013. Check stock and price before further orders. Purchase evidence: bom/sourcing/wasi-pulley-2026-10-08.md.

parts.name: Top-pulley offset steel mounting bracket — BAUHAUS Stabilit solid angle
requirements: 150 × 40 × 150 mm equal-leg solid angle, 5 mm galvanized steel. One per post: vertical leg through-bolted to timber; horizontal leg projects inward. Drill/enlarge two Ø13 mm mounting holes and one centred Ø9 mm shackle hole ~25 mm from the outer end for ~125 mm pulley offset.
parts.notes: Drill-only V1 solution; no welding. Deburr and recoat new holes with zinc-rich spray. Controlled proof-load required before overhead use.

parts.name: Top-pulley Dyneema keeper / weather cover
requirements: ASA preferred; PETG acceptable for prototype. Close side gaps around 1.5 mm Dyneema, keep line centred, prevent jump-off, shield direct rain/UV, drain below and remain removable for inspection.
parts.notes: Non-structural only; must not carry pulley or cable load and should not rub the line during normal running.

parts.name: Underground cable sleeve
requirements: For cables that run underground

parts.name: Single-layer grooved winch drum
requirements: Direct-drive, single-layer grooved drum on independent 8 mm shaft. No GT2 pulley, belt or gearbox in V1.
parts.notes: One assembled drum per BOM unit. Print three passive kits and one powered kit using hardware/assemblies/winch/README.md; source list is a variant/component library, not one copy of every source per drum. PLA first prototype; later ASA requires separate fit/process qualification. Full-travel powered drum is substantially wider and its shaft deflection is unvalidated.

parts.name: 8 mm steel drum shaft (variant cut allowance)
requirements: Solid nominal 8 mm steel shaft for the direct-drive drum, supported independently by bearings. Layout allowances: three passive shafts 340 mm and one powered shaft 660 mm; verify the full shaft stack before cutting.
Prototype selection: BAUHAUS hot-rolled stock. Inspect actual diameter, roundness, straightness and 608 bearing/coupling fit before use; no precision tolerance or structural qualification is claimed.
parts.notes: Owner-selected BAUHAUS 2000 mm stock rod. Modeled layout allocates 3 × 340 mm + 1 × 660 mm = 1680 mm before kerfs, leaving 320 mm for kerfs/offcut. This supersedes four approximate 400 mm blanks; length is not structural approval. Cutting, deburring, corrosion protection and fit finishing are not included in the stock price.

parts.name: Mechanical drum lock / fail-safe brake
requirements: Normally-engaged drum lock/brake for future revision; explicitly deferred after V1.

parts.name: Winch bearing/motor mount and guard
requirements: Motor mount, two bearing supports, line guide, coupling guard and weather cover for direct-drive winch.
parts.notes: Mount kit: per winch print two bearing lowers, two caps, one motor stand and one coupling guard. Requires separately budgeted rigid base, spacers and fasteners. The full shell is the separate winch-full-cover kit; line guidance, homing and powered slip-ring support remain unfinished. See hardware/assemblies/winch/mount.md and full-cover.md.

parts.name: 3.3 V RS485 transceiver module for wind sensor
requirements: MAX3485/SP3485-class 3.3 V UART↔RS485 module; one active + one spare. This is only for weather sensor, not motor control.

parts.name: RS485/Modbus wind-speed sensor
requirements: 12–24 V anemometer with Modbus RTU. Used to reject imaging and send pod to high dock above wind threshold.

parts.name: 3 mm wire-rope clamp
requirements: Stainless

parts.name: Zinc-rich spray for drilled pulley-bracket edges
requirements: Dupli-Color Basic zinc spray, 400 ml. Deburr, clean and coat every hole drilled through galvanized bracket/backing plates before outdoor assembly.
parts.notes: Protects exposed steel where drilling removes the factory zinc coating.

parts.name: Joining and clamp hardware for four segmented drums
requirements: One procurement set for three passive and one powered drum: five 1000 mm M5 threaded rods, 24 M5 locking nuts and 24 M5 washers; 24 M4×25 screws, eight M4×45 screws, 32 M4 locking nuts and 64 M4 washers.

Cut M5 rods into nine 280 mm and three 610 mm lengths. Three stock rods each yield 610+280 mm; two each yield 3×280 mm, leaving kerf allowance. Confirm actual screw lengths and access during bench assembly.
parts.notes: Explicit procurement allowance, not a confirmed commercial kit. Existing mixed fastener assortment has no verified size-level contents, so coverage is not assumed. See drum README.

parts.name: Rigid bases, bearing spacers and fasteners for four winch mounts
requirements: One unquoted procurement set for three passive and one powered mount: three 550×180×8 mm and one 880×180×8 mm aluminium base blanks; four 100×180×4 mm steel post backing plates. Dimensions are prototype assumptions, not structural ratings.
Eight steel bearing inner-ring spacers: nominal 8.2 mm bore, 11 mm OD, 2 mm thickness; verify actual bearing inner-ring contact annulus.
32 M6×30 base screws, 32 M6 locking nuts, 64 M6 washers; 16 M5×35 bearing-cap screws, 16 ordinary M5 hex nuts for captive windows and 16 M5 washers. Use a reviewed locking method on cap screws.

16 M4×20 coupling-cover screws, 16 M4 locking nuts and 32 M4 washers; 16 motor mounting screws/nuts/washers with diameter and length selected after inspecting received motor flange (M4×25 provisional allowance).
16 M8×160 post through-bolts, 16 M8 locking nuts and 32 large M8 washers; actual length and backing-plate fit depend on post thickness.
parts.notes: Not included in existing mixed fastener assortment without content verification. Supplier, grade, corrosion treatment, stock availability, shipping and prices unresolved. PLA inspection prototype only; powered shaft stiffness remains unresolved.

parts.name: Optional passive winch desk-foot kit
requirements: One bench kit contains two short and two long feet for the passive 550 x 180 x 8 mm base, using its existing 50 x 120 mm post-hole pattern.
35 mm plate underside height; existing mounting fasteners may protrude at most 25 mm below the plate.
Attach with four M8 x 35 bolts, eight standard M8 washers and four M8 nuts; these are separate from the printed parts.
Unloaded desk assembly and rotation checks only; physical fit and stability are unverified.
parts.notes: Optional bench fixture, excluded from installed-system assembly quantities and procurement totals. Print settings and installation: hardware/assemblies/winch/desk-feet.md. No structural or loaded-line qualification.

parts.name: Modular full-winch protective shell kit
requirements: One kit per winch: passive 3 main panels, 2 shutters, 6 fascia strips (one lower pole-port variant), 3 rear shield segments and one optional bench blank; powered 5 main panels including one index-1 pole middle, one plain index-2 middle and index-3 transition, 4 shutters, 10 fascia strips (one lower pole-port variant), 5 rear shields and one blank. Four r0.2.0 clips per panel and one independent loom anchor.
Warm-white rounded removable shell over existing dark core. Full-width 24 mm payout slot for 1.5 mm passive or nominal 4.5 mm hybrid line; no fixed fairlead or completed slip-ring support.
Concept-unvalidated: drilling, fit, full-travel abrasion, ventilation, heat, rain, strength and safe guarding require physical acceptance.

r0.3.0 bottom-loom layout: two 14 mm apertures near the pole; right-end ports closed. Provisional motor/encoder looms <=10 mm OD, routed under the drum. Independent anchor moves to X=W/2+60, Y=-60; add its revised base holes.
parts.notes: Three passive plus one powered kit retains 14 hoods, 10 shutters, 56 clips, four anchors, 28 fascia strips and 14 rear shields. Replace passive left/right and powered right at r0.3.0; add the powered pole middle and one pole fascia per winch. Reuse unchanged drivetrain, clips, shutters and common fascia. Round-pole saddles/caps are separate alternative kits. Physical fit, cable bend/strain relief and support acceptance remain open. See hardware/assemblies/winch/full-cover.md.

parts.name: Four-winch full-cover fastening and loom allowance
requirements: One unquoted set for 3 passive + 1 powered cover: 56 M4x16 shell screws, 56 plain M4 captive nuts and 56 M4 washers (9 mm OD). Use a reviewed removable screw-locking method.
56 M4x25 clip-to-base screws plus 8 M4x25 cable-anchor screws; 64 M4 locknuts and 128 M4 washers. Stack: 6 mm print, 8 mm base, two 0.8 mm washers, 5 mm locknut, 4.4 mm nominal tip projection.

Eight soft hook-and-loop loom wraps, <=5.5 mm wide and <=2.5 mm thick through the 6x3 mm base-anchor slots; eight soft-edged 14 mm bottom loom exits. Cable OD, connector size, bend radius, drip loop and strain relief require received-unit confirmation.

14 / 22 cover holes per passive / powered aluminium base, diameter 4.5 mm. Anchor holes now X=W/2+50 and W/2+70, Y=-60; reuse clip holes and add the relocated anchor pair to an old plate. Existing drivetrain/post holes retained.

16 steel M8 standoffs, 25 mm long, nominal 16 mm OD / 9 mm bore (four per winch), between the aluminium base and 100 mm timber post. Existing M8x160 length gives 11.8 mm nominal projection after 8 mm base, 25 mm spacer, 100 mm timber, 4 mm backing, two 1.6 mm washers and 8 mm locknut. Structural capacity, received stack and installation remain unverified; no printed structural spacers.
parts.notes: No supplier offers or prices asserted. Do not assume assortment coverage. Motor/encoder looms <=10 mm OD each are envelope assumptions. Separate rotating-conductor/slip-ring support remains unresolved.

parts.name: Round timber-pole machined metal saddle kit
requirements: Two front and two rear machined metal saddles per winch. Nominal pole diameter 120 mm, parameter study 100–140 mm. Existing four-hole 50x120 mm M8 pattern and 25 mm front offset retained. DO NOT print these load-bearing parts.
Material grade, stock, machining, corrosion treatment, contact fit, pole capacity and proof load require qualified review.
parts.notes: Optional round-timber interface; replace the flat-post standoffs/backing plate, do not combine both mounting stacks. No supplier quote or qualified material assertion. See hardware/assemblies/winch/round-pole.md.

parts.name: Round-pole nut covers and cable guide kit
requirements: Two white sliding rear nut covers, two snug underside closures and one dark two-loom cable guide per winch. Covers use metal saddle rails; remove underside closures before lifting caps. Guide tied to the pole independently of winch load.
Concept-unvalidated: print fit, underside closure/gravity-stop retention, vibration, UV and cable-clipping force require physical acceptance.
parts.notes: Optional round-timber interface; replace the flat-post standoffs/backing plate, do not combine both mounting stacks. No supplier quote or qualified material assertion. See hardware/assemblies/winch/round-pole.md.

parts.name: One-winch round-pole fastening allowance
requirements: Four M8 through-bolts, eight <=24 mm OD x 1.6 mm washers, four 8 mm high locking nuts. Nominal lengths 160 / 180 / 200 mm for 100 / 120 / 140 mm timber; confirm received stack and engagement.

Two non-structural outdoor soft ties through the guide paired 3x9 mm full-depth slots, <=2.5 mm wide and <=1 mm thick. Wrap the pole circumferentially and bridge the guide face at local Y=±3 mm; protect timber and loom jackets.
Replace the flat-post through-bolts/backing stack when selecting this round-pole alternative; structural/bolt-bending qualification remains open.
parts.notes: No prices or supplier offers asserted. See hardware/assemblies/winch/round-pole.md.
